title: Group I-3.
officialText:
In Group I-3 occupancies at least 2 percent, but no fewer than one of the total number of general holding
cells and general housing cells equipped with audible emergency alarm systems and permanently installed telephones within the
cell, shall comply with Section E104.3.4.
